notes.title: Minor Updates + Bug Fixes + News
notes.notes:
Two New Achievements

VIP - Platinum; Be at the top of the bi-weekly leaderboard.
Somebody Has to Flip the Burgers; At any time, have a total of $100,000 in chips.


Achievement Modifications

Bubbles! ; increased chances of achievement dropping by 50%


Bug Fixes

$10 -> $10 million glitch ; Fixed an issue where when betting $10, sometimes the game would recognize it as $10 million


Train Mode Infinite Lightning Glitch ; Fixed an issue where if given 2x consecutive Blackjacks, a never-ending barrage of lightning strikes would hit the timer forcing the player to quit.


News

Leaderboard Rewards
I have established a foundation for rewards based on player position on the leaderboards. Expect to see leaderboard rewards soon!

BlackJack Split Function
Will be available next update! 

Early Access Rewards
Will be available next update! 

Golden Wealth Feature (Store Item, Replaces Lightning)
Will be available next update!

notes.title: Version 3.0 - Multiple Updates
notes.notes:
Rather than releasing multiple tiny hot fixes, I decided to roll them into a major update. 

Features
Guides
Guides are now viewable by clicking on the 'LEARN' button at the home screen. It is a collapsible menu; it can be closed to save the real-estate on the main-menu screen.
https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/45095981/b7e37d4ea70c8544e5c3a1ad4277f1fb47398ac4.png

Opting Out of Leaderboards
At the Leaderboard menu, you now have the option to opt-out. This will prevent your place on the leaderboards from being shown at the main-menu and will prevent scores from being uploaded for privacy.

https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/45095981/383a22095a52cb04b7429bbc3f3623428b8af654.png

Report a Bug Button
At the main menu, there is a button in the bottom left corner where once clicked, will take you to a JabamiCollective page to report a bug

Chosen League Visible At Menu
When you have chosen a league/leaderboard to participate in, the chosen board will now show at the main menu.

https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/45095981/6a47419ceea5eb33cc711dd83305ce999438d7e8.png


BlackJack All in + Rebet
You can now use the all in and rebet buttons in the blackjack mode.

BlackJack FireBall Feature Bug Fix
Fixed a bug where x6, x7 and x8 fireballs were hitting more frequently.

Splash Art Update
Added JabamiCollective Branding to the SplashArt + Made with Unity

notes.title: Trainer - Mixed Pairs + FireBall Update
notes.notes:
Buffs to Fireball feature and addition of an extra feature.

Features
Mixed Pairs
When receiving a mixed pair from the first 2 cards dealt, receive 100 points if your total is below 100, or receive x1.10 ontop of your score if your total is 100 or over! 
https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/45095981/4458799e13f2360326b70d455a93fa53298ecd8b.png
The mixed pair is a free added feature; you do not need to buy it in order to equip it.

Leagues

Steam Profile Pictures now show next to high scores.
https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/45095981/caf1091d7283d2e972e5186feed2148b06821cbe.png


BlackJack FireBall Feature

If your score is above 100, it will provide x1.5 ontop of your score.

notes.title: [Early Access] UI Update Patch 1
notes.notes:
Summary of Update
The very first update in regards to the UI.
In this patch, I really wanted to give players an insight into the UI polish that is soon to come. I understand that first impressions matter, so I have prioritized the main menu and the other sub-menu windows.

The Learn & Store options will be completely redesigned and completed in the near future.



Build 2.2.5.1

UI

Main Menu UI Updated
New UI Interaction Sounds
Options UI Updated
Leaderboard UI Updated
Minor UI changes made to Train elements


https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/45095981/533e508c33f79258e4c090d8550e840260b03159.png

The marble panel on the left (seen in the screenshot) will have your Steam profile with a border and your current rank on the leaderboards (if you have an entry) as well as your chip balance. All of that is still being designed!

As always, questions, comments and feedback are all welcome.

Thank you!

notes.title: [Beta] Leaderboard Scores Patch #1
notes.notes:
Summary of Update
Leaderboards are now functioning and scores are actively being updated.

Tester Feedback
Ability to Opt Out
I have received feedback from testers that the option to opt-out online leaderboards should be available. I absolutely understand that not all players want their usernames on the board, with this in mind, I will include the option to opt out in the next Leaderboard patch.


Show Leaderboard Position w/out Need to Scroll
Currently a player needs to scroll through the board to find their entry. Testers have identified that it would be better to have an area on the boards to show where they are without needing to scroll through the list of scores.

Live Notification Option For Place In Leaderboards
This is a really good idea. I will look at executing this in later patches for the leaderboard section.
